nodes.label: FFmpeg LGPL v2.1 Compliance Notice
nodes.rationale: Records that FFmpeg is used under LGPL v2.1 and pins the exact upstream commit (5156578d1f486163d5b83f1d63246cd23d107933) so the corresponding source is identifiable — the same LGPL reasoning that makes PySide6 rather than PyQt5 the GUI choice.
